jobs.description: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. Our team builds the systems that make this possible. We record every agent desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail enforce policy on every tool call before it executes pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions and package the evidence for compliance frameworks. We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end-to-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high and the roadmap is concrete with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year. The team is small enough that your work goes to production fast and visibly. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you. Key job responsibilities • Own features end-to-end: design implement test deploy and operate in production * Build new services for policy enforcement session recording and replay and human-in-the-loop approval workflows * Integrate with AWS services and make build-vs-compose decisions with your team * Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines retention and access controls where correctness is the product * Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces * Contribute to operational excellence: oncall runbooks alarms and incident response A day in the life Your mornings are usually free for focus work - writing code reviewing CRs and working through whatever problem you've picked up. 회사 소개
CFS(Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화(Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 “쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?” 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
본 포지션은 외국인 임원을 직접 지원하는 Executive Assistant 역할로, 임원의 일정 및 업무를 지원하는 것을 넘어 조직 운영 전반이 원활하게 이루어질 수 있도록 다양한 운영 업무를 수행하는 포지션입니다.
Executive Assistant는 임원의 가장 가까운 비즈니스 파트너 중 한 명으로서 복잡한 일정과 우선순위를 관리하고, 국내외 이해관계자들과 긴밀하게 협업하며 조직 운영을 지원하게 됩니다. 또한 글로벌 환경에서 영어를 활용하여 커뮤니케이션하며, 인터뷰 코디네이션, 데이터 및 리포팅 지원, 워크샵 및 이벤트 운영 등 다양한 업무를 담당하게 됩니다.
빠르게 변화하는 환경 속에서 스스로 필요한 업무를 발굴하고 실행할 수 있는 적극성(Proactive Mindset), 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 역량, 그리고 다양한 이해관계자들과 신뢰 관계를 구축할 수 있는 대인관계 역량을 갖춘 분을 찾고 있습니다.
쿠팡 EA는 어떻게 일할까요?
실제 근무 중인 Executive Assistant들의 인터뷰를 통해 직무와 조직 문화를 보다 자세히 알아보실 수 있습니다.

jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. The ecosystem is ready to move. The hyperscalers, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft, are where a growing share of enterprise software now gets bought. One week you are running a joint go-to-market program at an industry event with a technology partner, drawing on a shared MDF budget. You will define what partner marketing looks like at ElevenLabs, then build it: the programs, the playbooks, and the relationships. The goal is to 11x the return we get from our partner relationships. BONUS - Experience marketing AI agents, contact center technology, or developer tooling. - Experience launching a product into a category that did not exist yet. GROWTH POTENTIAL We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. - Build the partner motion from 0 to 1, then build the team around it. North America is our largest market and this function will grow with it. - Go deep on the ecosystem and own alliances marketing across all three ElevenLabs platforms. - For those who want to go broader, there is a path to a B2B marketing leadership role as ElevenLabs scales in North America. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America with the ability to operate in PT or ET timezones. Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high-visibility & high-impact role driving AI adoption for one of our largest accounts in the Tech segment. In partnership with the broader account team, you will provide your customer best practices and guidance to getting the most impact with Claude in a safe, sustainable way while supporting them as their consumption grows and evolves.

Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the ROI of their investment. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.

• Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers in complex, matrixed organizations; understand their business and objectives and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion

• Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers and Sales/Product to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows
• Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement
• Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer to proactively drive consumption planning and the value story behind it, developing credible ROI hypotheses, and quantifying outcomes that build the case for continued and expanded investment
• Ruthlessly prioritize across the account's many business units and workstreams, building programmatic, repeatable motions

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, and/or Strategy Consulting
• Experience working with F10 companies at the exec level — ideally including established tech companies – you understand what it means to lead organization-wide change or adoption programs (multiple functions, thousands of users) for a product that required C-suite sponsorship
• Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders—from end users to executives
• You build with AI daily, automating your own workflows with agents, skills, and tooling is second nature, preferred experience with Claude Code
• Proven track record of driving measurable outcomes inside a single, highly matrixed organization with many business units. You treat customer asks as two-way exchanges: comfortable asking for commitments, references, and access in return, and pushing back on requests that aren't leveraged.
• Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs.

$200,000—$320,000 USD

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

AI Solution Design & Deployment

About the role

We're looking for a Strategic Projects Lead to take on recruiting's most complex, cross-cutting work: the high-stakes decisions and initiatives that span many teams and don't fit neatly into any one group's remit. You'll bring the structure, coordination, and follow-through that help these get made well, and see them through as the company scales.

You'll work across every team that touches hiring, and you'll move work forward through partnership, not ownership. The job is influence: bring the right people together, make sure decisions are principled and well-documented, and keep recruiting's approach coherent over time. You'll be the most senior individual contributor for how recruiting operates, and success depends as much as on building trust across senior stakeholders with different priorities as it does on building good systems.

This is a high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in complexity and ambiguity. You know recruiting well enough to feel where it breaks, and you're energized by holding several very different problems at once and driving each to a clear resolution.

Key responsibilities

• Take on recruiting's biggest ambiguous bets: define the problem, ship the smallest testable version, and hand each one off as a repeatable program before moving to the next
• Own the operating rhythm across the teams that support recruiting, so we plan, review, and decide as one function
• Spot recurring friction and fix the system behind it, not just the case in front of you
• Own process design when company-wide changes run through recruiting, and drive them to real adoption with the partners who own the build and the comms
• Be recruiting's DRI for headcount and workforce planning, including hiring pace and readiness for new regions
• Own the operating standard for interviewing, like scheduling lead time and interviewer load, and lead the cross-team diagnosis when it slips
• Turn analytics into standards and simple SOPs, and build documentation a new leader could pick up without you in the room
• Keep the right people informed at the right time without becoming a bottleneck, and stay fluent in our recruiting systems and data so you can call the downstream impact of any decision

You'll partner directly with the leads for Recruiting Systems, Analytics, Interview Programs, and other teams. You won't run their teams or build their systems, but you'll know each well enough to make calls that hold up across all of them.

Minimum qualifications

• Have 8-10+ years in program management, business operations, chief of staff, or people/talent roles at a fast-growing company, with increasing scope over time
• Have been part of a talent team or partnered closely with one, and understand how recruiting operates day to day
• Think in systems: you see how the pieces connect, anticipate downstream effects, and design fixes that work across team boundaries
• Have owned several complex workstreams at once and made hard prioritization calls without much guidance
• Set the strategy and vision for your area rather than executing someone else's plan
• Create structure and clarity in genuinely ambiguous environments
• Have put AI to work in real workflows: redesigning process, automating the repetitive layer, and shipping faster
• Test the smallest version of an idea in the real world before building the big one, and say clearly what you're not doing and why
• Can lose a decision cleanly: disagree, commit, and execute with full credibility, knowing which calls are reversible and which aren't
• Have taken a big process or policy change through an organization end to end and made it stick
• Close the loop, hold the bar, and finish the unglamorous work

Preferred qualifications

• Experience running recruiting or talent operations at global scale
• Working knowledge of recruiting compliance, like OFCCP, GDPR, and regional employment law, and how it shapes process and systems decisions
• Experience in deep-tech environments with technical recruiting complexity
